text_block_list.text:
I'm on my way back to campus with Fuji
Kiseki
when I realize something terrible.
You lost your phone?!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I empty my bag and pockets, but my
phone is
nowhere to be seen.

My blood runs cold when I remember all
the
confidential information from Tracen
that's stored
in it.
choice_data_list: I'll be in big trouble if that information leaks!

text_block_list.text: I bet... We'd better find it, and fast!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Hang on, don't you have a tablet that's
synced to
your phone?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
There's an app you can use to track
down your
lost phone if you're logged
into the same account
on both devices!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
As I have my tablet with me, I take it out
of my
bag, download the app in
question, and enter my
information.
Oh! The map's loaded!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
It looks like your phone's in a park...
maybe? It
seems to be moving around...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I squint at the screen and, sure enough,
the dot
indicating my phone's location is
moving about.

Maybe someone's picked it up. But it
doesn't look
like they're taking it to a
police station or a lost
and found...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
We might have to chase them down if
they're
some baddie trying to steal your
phone. Hang on,
I'll get changed!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Au contraire! It's always better to be
safe than
sorry! Let's head over once I've
changed!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Right, we're here! But... I don't see
anyone who
looks like a dastardly thief.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I suppose the only thing we can do now
is ask
around.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Meeeow.
text_block_list.name: Cat

text_block_list.text:
Why, hello! What a darling kitty! Say,
have you
seen a smartphone lying about
anywh—
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Nothing, just... look at what it's dragging
around.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Sure enough, there's a very familiar
phone on a
very familiar lanyard in its
mouth.
So it is yours! I thought I'd seen it before.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I can't believe it, but our phone
thief is a
cat! I've never seen a more
adorable thief!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
But there's no time to sit around and
laugh. I'll be
right back!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
She's off after the cat and out of sight
before I
can respond.

A considerable amount of time later, I
spot her
sprinting back toward me.
Huff! Huff! Sorry for the wait, but I got your phone back!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки is sopping wet, with a puddle
of water
growing at her feet.

Ahaha. Sorry for alarming you. It's kind
of a long
story, but...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Huff! Puff... My word, you are one nimble cat, aren't you?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Watch out, kitty! There's a lake over
there!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Plop!

Did you... Did you just drop the phone in
there?!
You might be cute, but you sure
are trouble!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Ack, I'd better fish out the phone before
it's a
goner!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
So that's the long and short of it. But
don't worry!
I'm not as drenched as I
appear. My undershirt is
still bone dry!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
She flashes me a disarming smile, but the
sweat
on her forehead tells me just how
daunting her
chase was.
choice_data_list: Hurry and buy her a change of clothes.

text_block_list.text:
It's okay! You don't have to give me a
drink! I
went looking for it because I
wanted to, that's all!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list:
Even so, you did a lot and need to stay
hydrated.

text_block_list.text:
That's a good point... Haha. I didn't
realize it till
now, but I'm parched!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Phew! Thank you! It was very refreshing.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: And thank you for going to such lengths for me.

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list:
Your clothes are all dirty because of that wild
cat chase.

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you're right! I'm covered in mud...
What a
state I'm in.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I was so focused on getting your phone
back that
I got total tunnel vision.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I must look pretty pathetic right now,
huh?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: Not at all. I'm grateful for your help.

text_block_list.text:
To think Фудзи Кисэки, who's usually so
well put
together, would literally crawl
through the mud
for me... It's just too
touching.

You are? Somehow, it's embarrassing
hearing you
say that.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: But... yeah, it makes sense.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
It's strange, but I always want to look my
best in
front of you.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
But since it brought back your beautiful
smile, I'll
gladly wear this bedraggled
look like a badge of
honor.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: For your smile is my treasure.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Are you sure I can use this? I'm covered
in mud,
you know.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: Of course I'm sure! That's what it's for!

text_block_list.text:
Okay... Then, thank you! I'll return it
tomorrow
after I wash it.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Phew! That feels so much better. I love
how fluffy
your towel is.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
It smells nice too... The scent is so gentle
and
calming.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I guess you don't notice since
you're used
to it.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Speaking of, I heard that you're more
genetically
compatible with people
whose scent you like.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: I think it might be true.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I did dive headfirst into a murky lake for
you
without hesitation, after all.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
When I think about it that way... you
may be even
more important to me than
I imagined.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Hehe. No need to get so embarrassed.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Say, Trainer... What am I to you?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Do you find my scent pleasing as well?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: You're gonna go buy some for me?! It's all right! You don't have to go out of your way to do that!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Really, I'm fine. I'll be dry again in no
time.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Despite her reassurances, I'd still hate
for her to
catch a cold.
choice_data_list: I'll be right back, so wait here!

text_block_list.text:
I run to the nearest convenience store
and hurry
back, only to find...

I obviously can't change her clothes
myself, but I
can't just leave her there
either. I also wouldn't
want to wake her
up.
I decide to carry her home on my back.
...Wha?! T-Тренер?!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Oh... Sorry. I must've fallen asleep while
I was
waiting.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I felt someone picking me up, but in my

half-asleep state, I thought it was my
mother.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Yes. Your back felt so sturdy and warm...
It
reminded me of a time my mother
carried me,
long ago.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I must've mistaken you for her because
you're just
as important to me as she is...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Sorry. That was weird, wasn't it. I must
still be
muddled with sleЭпизод
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, we'd better hurry home. Get it
together,
Fuji!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: ...Please pretend that didn't happen.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки is unsteady on her feet, so I
support
her all the way back to the
academy.

She smiles at me, soft and warm, and we
admire
the sunset in amiable silence.

The next day, I find my towel waiting for
me in my
office, folded up nice and
neat.
